C1240.title: LexisNexis Reveals Two Methods of Synthetic Identity Creation
C1240.summary: LexisNexis Risk Solutions analysis identifies two categories of synthetic identity fraud: manipulated synthetic identities, which make limited alterations to real identities to conceal adverse history, and manufactured synthetic identities, which assemble valid data from multiple identities or create entirely new identities using invalid SSNs within the same range as SSA randomly issued numbers.
